text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Under the Card Dispute Procedure (Rev 5), the agent completes Form HCU-DSP-114 (Card Transaction Dispute) during the initial contact for every dispute \\u2014 whether the member contacts us by phone, in branch, or through secure message. In the intake steps, it's completed after verifying the caller, confirming the transaction details and (if fraud is suspected) blocking the card, and it is followed by reading the dispute acknowledgment disclosure and routing the case to the Card Services dispute queue. The completed form is then retained with the case record for at least two years from resolution.","cited_chunk_ids":["card_dispute_procedure::layout::B_structure::0001","card_dispute_procedure::layout::B_structure::0006"],"reason":"The intake section states directly when the form is completed, and the retention section adds what happens to it afterwards."}
